status: Draft for business review; not executed

gates.G1: Approve source statuses, unknown-status mapping, deletion/test flags and deduplication normalization.
gates.G2: Approve creation versus confirmation time, current-month/default dates, weekly boundaries, filter relationships, and section-specific Reset behavior.
gates.G3: Approve page size (proposed25) and stable queue tie-breaker. Session tie-breaker proposed start time then ID.
gates.G4: Map roles, profile transitions, reason rules/length, document permissions, audit/notification contract, version and retry/idempotency protocol.
gates.G5: Approve today-through-next30-days meaning (proposed 15Oct–14Nov inclusive), already-started sessions today, booking cutoffs, and session status mapping.
gates.G6: Approve booking authority, capacity/block representation, holds/release boundaries, cancellation release and waitlist semantics.
gates.G7: Approve freshness, accessibility standard/browser matrix and representative performance workload/targets. Five-minute freshness, WCAG2.2AA, p95 three-second summaries/two-second acknowledgement remain proposals.

fixtures: Synthetic enrollment fixture; V1/R1 scoped to C1, R2 second C1 reviewer; wider-scope user sees C1+C2. Explicit period 15–31 October2026 IST. E01 C1/X/confirmed at15Oct00:00; E02 C1/X/pending at15Oct12:00, same candidate K1 as E01; E03 C1/Y/confirmed16Oct; E04 C1/unmapped/cancelled31Oct23:59:59.999; E05 C2/X/confirmed16Oct; E06 C1/Y/pending17Oct; E07 C1/X/confirmed17Oct; E08 C1/X/expired18Oct. Default values not flagged deleted/test. Source status labels are fixture labels pending G1 mapping.

C1 total7; X4/Y2/Unspecified1; confirmed3/pending2/cancelled1/expired1; daily15Oct2,16Oct1,17Oct2,18Oct1,31Oct1; all other days0. Wider scope total8, X5/Y2/Unspecified1, confirmed4. Duplicates of same ID do not add count.

Synthetic K001–K030 references only. Q01/Q02/Q03 pending version1; 26 pending C1 profiles with increasing submission timestamps, plus finalized profiles and C2 controls. Reviewer capabilities and transition mapping are provisioned in isolated test environment after G4 approval. Use fresh record per destructive case; restore fixture between cases.

Synthetic scheduled sessions within and outside range; S-normal100/70/5; S-full100/100/0; S-closed100/70/5 with booking closed; S-cancelled; S-over100/105/5; S-zero0/0/0; missing-capacity row; equal-start-time rows; C2 controls and26-row pagination set. Each scenario declares raw versus sellable capacity and authoritative availability.

Freeze clock and seed/restore independent synthetic dataset per case. Use controllable adapters/proxy for latency, failure, lost acknowledgements and record conflicts. Capture build, browser, user capability/scope, fixture version, applied filters, effective timestamps, expected/actual and correlation IDs. Run mutation/security checks only in an authorized isolated environment.

cases.title: Scoped dashboard loads
cases.preconditions: F1 dataset; viewer V1; valid source adapters; select 15–31 October 2026.
steps: Sign in as V1 and open the dashboard.
Apply the fixture date range and inspect each section.
cases.expected: Total 7; statuses 3 confirmed, 2 pending, 1 cancelled, 1 expired; exam counts X=4, Y=2, Unspecified=1; C2 records absent; section timestamps shown.

cases.title: Distinct IDs and payment retry deduplication
cases.preconditions: F1 plus duplicate physical rows/payment retries for E01 and E02.
steps: Refresh all enrollment summaries.
Compare totals, daily buckets, exam groups and status groups.
cases.expected: Each enrollment ID counted once; total remains 7; all three breakdowns reconcile. Multiple enrollments by candidate K1 still contribute 2.

cases.title: Deleted and test exclusions
cases.preconditions: F1 plus D01 deleted and T01 test records using approved source flags.
steps: Query the fixture period.
Inspect summaries and drill-down rows.
cases.expected: D01 and T01 excluded consistently; total remains 7. Exact exclusion flags must be approved before execution.

cases.title: Conjunctive filter application
cases.preconditions: F1; V1; date range fixture; exam X; centre C1; status confirmed.
steps: Change exam, centre and status controls without Apply.
Press Apply and inspect all enrollment sections.
Open the matching enrollment list.
cases.expected: Before Apply last applied data remains. After Apply total 2 (E01,E07), status confirmed 2, X share 100.0%; drill-down retains all four filters.

cases.title: Current-month default and Reset
cases.preconditions: Freeze clock at 15 October 2026 12:00 IST; V1; alternate filters already applied.
steps: Open a fresh dashboard.
Change and apply filters, then use Reset.
cases.expected: Explicit defaults show 1–31 October 2026 IST; Reset restores current month and other documented defaults without widening authorized scope.
cases.approval_gate: G2 filter mapping and date defaults

cases.title: IST start and exclusive end boundaries
steps: Apply selected dates.
Inspect source IDs and bucket assignments.
cases.expected: Include E01/E04; exclude B0/B9. UTC query interval is [2026-10-14T18:30:00Z,2026-10-31T18:30:00Z).

cases.title: Single-day, month and leap-day ranges
cases.preconditions: Synthetic rows just before, at and after 29 Feb 2028 IST and 31 Dec 2026 IST; controllable clock.
steps: Select 29 February 2028 as both dates and apply.
Repeat for 31 December 2026 and the following day.
cases.expected: Only rows in each selected local day appear; end-date rollover handles leap month and year boundary without truncation or overflow.

cases.title: Invalid date range preserves valid results
cases.preconditions: F1 valid results visible.
steps: Set start to 31 October and end to 15 October 2026.
Try Apply and send equivalent invalid service input in an authorized test environment.
Try missing/invalid date values where the control permits entry.
cases.expected: Accessible field validation; no invalid query changes data; service rejects invalid input; previous results and effective timestamp retained.

cases.title: IST bucketing independent of browser zone
cases.preconditions: F1 plus boundary UTC timestamps; browser configured to UTC and then America/New_York.
steps: Load identical applied dates in each browser zone.
Compare daily labels, counts and timestamp labels.
cases.expected: Both use IST enrollment creation day, identical counts and explicit IST labels; browser locale does not shift membership.

cases.title: Zero days and daily reconciliation
steps: Inspect daily chart and equivalent table.
Sum buckets, statuses and exam counts independently.
cases.expected: 17 day buckets; 15th=2,16th=1,17th=2,18th=1,31st=1; other days zero. Every breakdown sums to 7.

cases.title: Weekly and monthly grouping
cases.preconditions: F1 plus records across a week/year boundary; approve week-start convention first.
steps: Switch daily to weekly then monthly.
Compare underlying membership, boundary labels and total.
cases.expected: All groupings sum to the same total; partial buckets include only selected dates. Week-start/labels follow approved convention.

cases.title: Unknown or missing source status
cases.preconditions: F1 plus one source status outside approved mapping and one missing status.
steps: Load status breakdown and total.
Inspect mapping/error diagnostics.
cases.expected: No silent loss or double count; totals reconcile under explicitly approved unknown-status handling. Business label assignment blocked until mapping agreed.

cases.title: Exam shares and rounding
cases.preconditions: F1 C1 total=7.
steps: Read count-sorted exam chart and table.
Compare percentage calculation and rounding notice.
cases.expected: X=4 (57.1%), Y=2 (28.6%), Unspecified=1 (14.3%); one decimal, counts descending; chart and table identical. Rounding notice present; do not assert all rounded datasets sum to 100%.

cases.title: Renamed and unmapped exams
cases.preconditions: F1; two X display names with same stable exam ID; E04 has unmapped exam.
steps: Refresh distribution.
Select X and inspect drill-down.
cases.expected: X remains one group with 4; E04 retained under Unspecified=1; X drill-down keeps date, centre and status and shows matching IDs.

cases.title: Successful zero-result query
cases.preconditions: Valid filters with no authorized matching enrollments; sources return success.
steps: Apply filters and inspect summaries/chart/table.
Refresh once.
cases.expected: Explicit no-enrollments state; count zero where appropriate; no percentage, NaN, Infinity or divide-by-zero error; successful timestamp distinguishable from error.

cases.title: Separate filter domains
cases.preconditions: F1/P1/S1; configure approved exam/centre relationship mapping.
steps: Change enrollment date range only.
Change profile submission dates only.
Change session dates only; inspect inapplicable exam/centre controls.
cases.expected: Each date affects only its labelled domain; applicable shared filters respect approved relationships; inapplicable controls are labelled and do not silently remove unrelated records.

cases.title: Oldest pending queue and exact search
cases.preconditions: P1 profiles; V1 viewer and reviewer R1 scoped C1.
steps: Open default queue and compare submission order.
Search exact candidate reference K001, then a partial nonmatching fragment.
Inspect masked reference and available Review navigation.
cases.expected: Pending profiles oldest first; exact search yields only permitted match; partial query does not broaden to unintended candidates; sensitive identifiers masked; names shown only where permitted; no identity documents on dashboard.

cases.title: Queue pagination and review-status filter
cases.preconditions: P1 has 26 pending profiles plus approved/rejected profiles; proposed page size 25.

Change review-status filter and inspect pagination.
cases.expected: 25 then 1 pending record with no duplication/omission in unchanged data; filter changes reset or clamp invalid page; approved/rejected rows only under selected status; deterministic tie-breaker to be agreed.

cases.title: Profile navigation and return state

steps: Open a permitted profile through Review.
Return to dashboard.
Repeat with review destination unavailable.
cases.expected: Existing authorized review page opens; filter/sort/page preserved where valid; unavailable destination has clear message and dashboard remains reachable.

cases.title: Approve once with confirmation and audit
cases.preconditions: R1; P1 pending Q01 at version 1; approved transition permits approve; audit access for verifier.
steps: Choose Approve; verify confirmation candidate and action.
Confirm once and inspect saved status, queue and audit.
cases.expected: One approved transition and one audit event with actor, timestamp, prior/new status and reason where applicable; queue refreshed only after successful save.

cases.title: Rejection/correction requires reason
cases.preconditions: R1; separate fresh pending profiles Q02/Q03; approved decisions available.
steps: Try reject with blank and whitespace-only reason.
Try request correction with blank reason.
Provide valid reason and confirm each decision on fresh records.
cases.expected: Missing/whitespace reason blocked with accessible error; valid allowed reason and confirmed action save exact permitted transition and audit reason.

cases.title: Cancel decision confirmation
cases.preconditions: R1; fresh pending profile.
steps: Choose each available decision and open confirmation.
Cancel before submitting; reload profile.
cases.expected: No state change, mutation or audit decision event; original profile and queue unchanged.

cases.title: Duplicate submission during request
cases.preconditions: R1; delayed decision response; fresh versioned pending profile.
steps: Confirm Approve and immediately repeat click/Enter.
Observe requests and persisted decision.
cases.expected: Confirmation disabled while in flight; one effective transition and one decision audit event; repeated attempts cannot duplicate side effects.

cases.title: Concurrent reviewers and version conflict
cases.preconditions: R1 and R2 authorized; both open Q01 version 1 in independent sessions.
steps: R1 approves version 1 successfully.
R2 attempts rejection against version 1.
Reload R2 details.
cases.expected: Second mutation refused as conflict; first decision preserved; clear conflict message and current version/status reloaded; no second successful decision audit event.

cases.title: Permission revoked between open and save
cases.preconditions: R1 opens valid pending record; controlled admin revokes review capability before confirmation.
steps: Submit previously opened decision.
Inspect service response, status and audit.
cases.expected: Server rechecks authorization, denies mutation and does not disclose protected details; existing status unchanged; UI provides safe permission message.

cases.title: Invalid transition and forged version
cases.preconditions: R1; already-finalized record; authorized API test harness.
steps: Attempt unsupported action/status and forged/stale version directly.
Reload record and inspect audit.
cases.expected: Server validates allowed transition and version; rejects tampering; no overwrite or successful decision event for failed mutation.

cases.title: Review failure before commit and retry
cases.preconditions: R1; simulate service failure before transaction commits.
steps: Submit valid decision and observe error.
Verify current status, restore service and retry.
cases.expected: Previous status retained and failure visible; retry possible; eventual save creates one effective transition/audit event; queue refreshed after success only.

cases.title: Lost acknowledgement after commit
cases.preconditions: R1; controlled proxy drops first response after server commits.
steps: Confirm decision once and drop acknowledgement.
Use offered recovery/retry and reload authoritative record.
Inspect audit and notification side effects where approved.
cases.expected: Recovery determines current status or uses safe deduplication/version enforcement; committed decision never repeated or overwritten; one effective transition and audit event. Exact retry protocol requires engineering agreement.

cases.title: Upcoming range, sort and IST details
cases.preconditions: S1; freeze now at 15 October 2026 12:00 IST; proposed initial range 15 October–14 November inclusive.
steps: Open sessions and inspect displayed range/fields.
Apply explicit session date bounds and inspect equal-time rows.
cases.expected: Only scheduled noncancelled scoped sessions within date range; full fields present; start-time ascending then session-ID order; timestamps IST. Already-started-today handling awaits G5.
cases.approval_gate: G5 session horizon and started-session rule

cases.title: Full, closed and cancelled sessions

steps: Load upcoming list.
Inspect session and booking labels.

Compare displayed capacity, allocations, holds and availability.

Advance clock to expiry and refresh authoritative state.
Read just after expiry.

cases.title: Blocked seats included/excluded in capacity

Compare available seats and capacity labels.

steps: Load all three rows.
Retry failed availability after restoring service.

steps: Read availability with unallocated waitlist.
Follow existing booking path if available after another user consumes last seat.
cases.expected: Unallocated waitlist does not consume seats; booking source revalidates and prevents allocation based solely on stale dashboard count; dashboard itself reserves nothing.

cases.title: Session pagination and read-only navigation

steps: Visit page1, page2 and back.
Open session details and return.
cases.expected: No missing/duplicate rows for static data; start-time/ID stable ordering; details read-only; relevant list state preserved.

cases.title: Independent section failure and retry
cases.preconditions: Healthy dashboard; force exam-distribution request failure only.
steps: Refresh and inspect all sections.
Retry only failed section with service recovered.
cases.expected: Healthy sections usable; failed section has Error/Retry, no misleading zero; stale retained data labelled with previous timestamp; retry keeps filters and updates failed section only.

cases.title: Out-of-order filter responses
cases.preconditions: Intercept requests: filter A returns slowly, B quickly; counts differ.
steps: Apply A, immediately apply B.
Deliver B then A responses, including A errors.
Inspect filters, totals, tables and timestamps.
cases.expected: Only B data/error state survives across all sections; late A cannot overwrite B counts, timestamp or loading/error state.

cases.title: Manual refresh and snapshot consistency
cases.preconditions: F1; commit one extra enrollment during refresh; adapter supports agreed snapshot/effective timestamp.
steps: Refresh with fixed filters as new record commits.
Compare aggregates and per-section effective timestamps.
cases.expected: Enrollment totals and breakdowns describe one consistent population/snapshot and reconcile; filters retained; no mixture of partial old/new aggregate versions.

cases.title: Freshness target measurement

Refresh through supported mechanism and record first visible updated value.
Repeat agreed scenarios and retain source/display timestamps.
cases.expected: Observed freshness measured against approved threshold; proposed 5 minutes is informational until signed off. Failures/stale data not counted as fresh.

cases.title: Loading, empty, permission and error distinction

steps: Exercise each response independently.
Inspect visible and assistive status announcements.
cases.expected: Distinct labelled states; no stale zero during loading; errors/forbidden never represented as empty; loading/error announcements accessible without moving focus unexpectedly.

cases.title: Keyboard-only dashboard and confirmations
cases.preconditions: Supported desktop browser; keyboard only; approved interactive review path.
steps: Tab/Shift+Tab through filters, Apply/Reset, charts/table links, queue, pagination and Retry.
Open and cancel review confirmation using keyboard.
Submit a valid decision using keyboard on fresh profile.
cases.expected: Visible focus and logical order; every function reachable; no keyboard trap; dialog labelled, focus contained while open and restored on close; required reason errors associated with field.

cases.title: Screen reader and chart equivalents
cases.preconditions: Supported screen reader/browser pairing; nonzero and empty fixture states.
steps: Navigate landmarks/headings and controls.
Read chart summaries and data tables.
Trigger validation, refresh and section error.
cases.expected: Descriptive labels; chart text values match charts; table headers associated; statuses announced; meaning survives absent color; no duplicate misleading accessible names.

cases.title: Narrow viewport and zoom
cases.preconditions: 320 CSS pixel viewport and 200% browser zoom; long exam/centre names and references.
steps: Inspect each section and operate controls.
Access every queue/session table field by intended responsive interaction.
cases.expected: Sections stack; content and actions readable; no clipped confirmations, inaccessible fields or obstructed focus; essential content remains usable at approved reflow target.

cases.title: Centre-scope API and URL tampering

steps: Alter centre filters, URL parameters, enrollment/profile/session IDs to C2.
Call aggregate/list/detail services directly with C2 identifiers.
cases.expected: Server denies or returns only authorized C1 scope; no C2 counts, names, existence details or cached data disclosed; authorization enforced independently of hidden UI controls.

cases.title: Viewer cannot mutate or view documents
cases.preconditions: V1 read-only; valid C1 profile and protected identity-document URL.
steps: Inspect viewer UI.
Attempt decision mutation directly and access document endpoint without document permission.
cases.expected: No permitted review mutation; service denies; document access separately checked even if dashboard viewing permitted; no identity document preview on dashboard.

cases.title: Logout, expiry and account-switch cache
cases.preconditions: R1 with wider data then V1 with C1-only scope on same browser; expire token during load.
steps: Load wider-scope data, sign out, sign in as V1.
Use browser Back and refresh; expire V1 token and retry a request.
cases.expected: Prior user's protected data not retained in accessible dashboard state/cache; expired session requires existing authentication recovery; no requests succeed with revoked/expired authorization.

cases.title: Untrusted labels, reasons and input tampering
cases.preconditions: Authorized fixture includes HTML/script-like exam/candidate/centre labels and review reason; service harness.
steps: Display labels and audit reason safely.
Submit malformed/oversized filter values and unauthorized action fields.
Verify existing anti-forgery protection for cookie-based mutations, if applicable.
cases.expected: Text escaped, no script execution; inputs validated; no stack trace/data leak; unauthorized mass-assignment fields rejected/ignored; cross-site mutation prevented under actual authentication scheme.
cases.approval_gate: G4 reason limits and authentication contract

cases.title: Privacy-safe errors and telemetry
cases.preconditions: Authorized access to test logs/telemetry; exact candidate-reference search and failed review.
steps: Search sensitive reference; trigger controlled failure.
Inspect client events, server logs and visible error.
cases.expected: No candidate names, identity documents or sensitive search terms in telemetry; error uses correlation ID without secrets/stack trace; audit retains required decision fields only in authorized audit mechanism.

cases.title: Dashboard performance measurement
cases.preconditions: Production-sized synthetic dataset, approved concurrency/network/cache conditions and harness; no real PII.
steps: Measure summaries-ready time across agreed samples including cold/warm runs.
Compute p95 and retain dataset, concurrency, sample counts and timings.
Measure review acknowledgement separately with external dependency exclusions identified.
cases.expected: Compare to approved targets. Proposals: summaries p95<=3s and acknowledgement<=2s excluding external dependencies; no pass assertion before target/workload approval.

cases.title: Permission error preserves authorized neighbors
cases.preconditions: User retains enrollment/session permission but lacks profile queue permission.
steps: Load dashboard and force queue response forbidden.
Attempt queue Retry and open direct profile URL.
cases.expected: Queue shows appropriate access state; authorized sections usable; no leaked queue metadata or misleading zero; retry never escalates access.

steps: Apply profile submission start/end dates with pending status.

cases.title: Session range boundaries

steps: Apply explicit session range independent of default horizon.
Compare displayed session IDs and IST times.
cases.expected: Selected local-date boundaries inclusive; following midnight excluded; cancelled still excluded and scope enforced.

cases.title: Expired/cancelled allocations and source authority
cases.preconditions: Booking authority fixture with released cancellation, active allocation, expired hold and differing stale arithmetic inputs.
steps: Refresh after authoritative allocation-release transitions.
Compare source-provided availability with displayed result.
cases.expected: Uses authoritative availability; released allocations/expired holds follow booking source contract; no dashboard-specific double release or contradictory recomputation.

steps: Open each drill-down in turn under controlled failure.
Return/retry dashboard navigation.
